Is the lighting on the rocks artificial?
Lighting might be artificial.
Format:[Yes/No]
thinking: The user wants a yes/no answer on whether the lighting on the rocks is artificial. Looking at the image, there are small bright spots embedded in the rock walls (left side and right side) that look like installed lights—warm-colored points of light that aren't from the sky. The blue light in the gap is natural skylight, but the warm illumination on the rock surfaces comes from fixtures. So yes, lighting is artificial. The format requires just Yes/No.
